mapping.source: Sealed gold field/entity IDs, type and context refs. Never modify annotations.
mapping.tablePrecedence: Nonempty structured tables first; Markdown pipe tables only when no nonempty table array exists. Cross-format duplication is not record duplication.
mapping.H01: RFC document header before Abstract/Status/TOC, max8000chars; RFC ID/title/category/month/authors. Title may use explicit page metadata; no fetch-time substitution.
mapping.H02: Top100 EBooks yesterday heading section, records by same-link ebook URL/id, title by author (count); first report table ISO day; explicit downloads context.
mapping.H03: Constant quantity in first cell, symbol second, numeric value and unit in third. No year/date inference.
mapping.H04: England and Wales2027 table caption; same-row date/weekday/name, year from caption.
mapping.H05: Named prefix cell with next symbol/factor; exponent operators or actual powers of ten only; concatenate1030 never repaired to10^30. Updated date must be explicit.
mapping.H06: Status code first cell, description second, reference third; Last Updated source label date.
mapping.H07: WCAG2.2 title, W3C Recommendation header date, For Level A/AA/AAA conformance clauses rather than TOC.
mapping.H08: Method article title, parameter term lines in Parameters, first Return value paragraph, explicit last-modified date; capture time forbidden.
mapping.urlNormalization: Only fixture origin is rebased to original source origin; original path retained. Raw serialized URLs remain stored.
mapping.valueNormalization: Whitespace/Markdown links, typographic apostrophes, exact Decimal without rounding; IDs/SI symbols preserve case. Dates preserve month/day precision.

metrics.primary: Fully correct required fields /75, requiring entity,value,known unit,date,period and same-source hash. All77slots including optional separately reported.
metrics.fieldCorrectness: Fully correct /observed fields, with missing and value-only/context-missing counts separate; null denominator stays null.
metrics.evidence: Independent source locatability from immutable gold proof plus same-source hash and output location; explicit product field citations are not requested and not claimed.
metrics.duplicates: Extra records among selected identities in primary representation; article duplicate rate not estimated.
metrics.taskAccepted: All required selected fields fully correct and no selected-record duplicate. Configured identity checks remain separate.
metrics.unknown: Missing/unresolvable output never filled from expected labels or capture timestamp. Unexpected output shapes remain evaluator-unresolved; diagnostic review cannot change the frozen primary score.

stop: Pause before startup/next slot on actual other tests/acceptance/API or13:50–14:10/20:50–21:10 CST; close own services. Attempted slots never rerun. Source/runtime fault recorded as first failure. No selector/code/contract tuning after unseal.
